definitions.explanation: Intestinal bacteria thought to harm health, for example by producing toxins or causing putrefaction. A popular rather than scientific term.

examples.japanese: {悪玉菌|あくだまきん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{増|ふ}える→増える：01183_fueru⟧。
{腸内|ちょうない}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{悪玉菌|あくだまきん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{減|へ}らしたい→減らす：02414_herasu⟧。
examples.english: I want to reduce the bad bacteria in my gut.

examples.japanese: ⟦{肉|にく}→肉：02240_niku⟧⟦ばかり→〜ばかり：02006_bakari⟧⟦{食|た}べている→食べる：00396_taberu⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{悪玉菌|あくだまきん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{増|ふ}え→増える：01183_fueru⟧、⟦{便秘|べんぴ}→便秘：05383_benpi⟧や⟦{肌荒|はだあ}れ→肌荒れ：08421_hadaare⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{原因|げんいん}→原因：01400_genin⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧いわれる。
examples.english: Eating nothing but meat is said to increase bad bacteria and cause constipation and rough skin.

notes:
Common in health articles and yogurt advertising.
